inputs.label: Your own dump of the USA V1.000 release (F888 / T-40203N): pick the .gdi sheet with its track files beside it, or a .chd image.

settings.label: Display mode
settings.help: Borderless fullscreen fills the screen and still switches apps quickly. Exclusive fullscreen gives the game the screen to itself and can change the panel's refresh rate.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at, before the window's shape is applied. 1x is the console's own 640 x 480; higher is sharper and needs a faster graphics card. 6x is 4K in a 16:9 window.

settings.label: Widescreen
settings.help: Off keeps the console's 4:3. 16:9 and 21:9 widen the field of view instead of stretching the picture; menus and loading cards keep their shape.

settings.label: Field of view
settings.help: The vertical field of view in degrees. 90 is the game's own; wider shows more of the world and everything looks smaller, narrower zooms in. It works together with Widescreen.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.help: The game logic stays at the console's 60 Hz. A higher present rate repeats the picture unless interpolation is on, which draws the frames between for smoother motion (and costs more GPU time).

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: On keeps the picture in step with the display. Off presents immediately: less latency, but the picture can tear.

settings.label: Frame counter
settings.help: Starts with the frame-rate overlay on. F10 toggles it in game.

settings.label: Controls
settings.help: Classic is the Dreamcast pad. Modern is the twin-stick layer: left stick moves and strafes, right stick turns, LT blocks and RT attacks.

settings.label: HD rumble (RenHDrum)
settings.help: On sends rumble through RenHDrum: a DualSense's voice-coil actuators, a Switch Pro Controller's HD Rumble, an Xbox pad's four motors. Off is the original two-motor rumble.

settings.label: Trigger feedback
settings.help: Every rumble becomes a short buzz in a trigger: the left one while blocking, both for hits. Needs a wired DualSense.

settings.label: Brightness / gamma
settings.help: Gamma on the finished picture: 100% is the game's own; above it lifts dark and mid tones, below it deepens them. F11 and F12 captures keep the game's unmodified frame.

settings.label: Sound
settings.help: Off runs the game silently and skips the audio device entirely.

settings.label: CPU clock
settings.help: Gives the game more cycles in each frame, which can help it draw every frame at high resolutions. Overclocks can affect game speed and audio on some machines: use with caution.

settings.label: Crash log
settings.help: Keeps this run's output and, if the game dies, a crash report in %APPDATA%\dream-recomp\logs. Turn it on to make a bug report, then send the newest file.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: Your memory card: every save the game has made. Backed up and synced with the game.

actions.label: Settings
actions.help: The launcher's settings file and your controller bindings.

exit_codes.2: The game couldn't start: your disc wasn't accepted, or the window or sound device couldn't open. It needs the USA V1.000 release as a .gdi with its tracks, or a .chd.
